treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily as first‑line antihypertensive per NICE NG136, titrating to target BP. Add amlodipine 5 mg daily if BP remains uncontrolled after ACE‑I optimisation. Initiate atorvastatin 20 mg nightly and metformin 500 mg daily pending QRISK, lipid, HbA1c, renal and potassium results. Monitor BP, renal function, electrolytes, and liver enzymes as outlined by NICE. Provide lifestyle advice (low‑salt diet, exercise, weight loss) and arrange investigations to fill data gaps before finalising therapy.
